name: Lifetime® 6-Foot Faux Wood Fold-Away Picnic Table
description: Lifetime 6-Foot Faux Wood Fold-Away Picnic Table Get everything you want in an outdoor table with the Lifetime 6-Foot Faux Wood Picnic Table. Now you an enjoy the beauty of wood without the constant maintenance, and you'll also appreciate the portable folding design. This wood look picnic table is constructed of UV-protected high-density polyethylene and powder-coated steel for weather resistance against rusting, fading, and peeling. Stain resistant tabletop is easy to clean, and you'll appreciate that this portable 6 foot picnic table folds flat for convenient transportation to campgrounds, family reunions, or winter storage. Lifetime 6-Foot Picnic Table -The 72" x 30" high-density polyethylene tabletop is stain resistant, easy to clean, and folds flat for storage. This model comes in brown with a wood grain texture and a bronze 1-5/8" round folding frame that includes anumbrella hole and cap. Single box packaging. 2-year limited warranty. 76.50 L. 30.50 W. 4.73 H.
